description:
AstroCrew presents ARES PROTOCOL, a distributed engineering lab on Roblox (Luau) using custom N-body physics.

• Proposal: A public digital twin crowdsourcing human decision data to train NASA Artemis navigation AIs.

• Missions:

Mars: Base maintenance. • Europa: Subsurface ocean. • Earth: Carbon cleanup. • Moon: Farside radio & ice mining.

• Highlights: Real-time NASA DONKI solar data integration. • 100% procedural 3D scale & Luau orbital mechanics.
